summary: The workspace server now includes the UTF-8 content in a `previewFile` text result. FilePane passes that content straight to the editors, so the separate `readFile` query is gone. The protocol version moves to 29, and an older server rejects the new client through `checkServerCompatibility`. The source logic is sound: the text checks match `readFile`, the editors read `loaded` only on mount, and the autosave cache updater leaves an evicted query alone. It is not ready because the temp-test run fails: three stale temp tests under tmp/loading-speed-merge/ fail on module imports.

findings.body: The temp-test run fails (see .tmp-tests/report/tmp.log, lines 4143-4178). Three temp test files under the scratch copy tmp/loading-speed-merge/ fail when vitest loads them: `Cannot find module '../serverTest.js'`, `'../client.js'`, and `'../extensionTest.js'`. Their relative helper imports do not resolve from that leftover folder. They belong to a stale merge workspace, not to this change, and the real copy at packages/workspace-server/test/.tmp-tests/contentLoading.spec.ts already passes. Remove the tmp/loading-speed-merge .tmp-tests files (or the whole scratch folder, after checking it is not in use), or move any needed test into the real package's .tmp-tests folder, so the temp run passes. The same failure applies to tmp/loading-speed-merge/packages/extension-sdk/src/.tmp-tests/client.test.ts:5 and tmp/loading-speed-merge/packages/extension-tools/test/.tmp-tests/loading.test.ts:2.
